title: promote-release.mjs hand-cut hint: key it on the failed action and give a body-file recipe (QCLI-516 review follow-ups)
description: Follow-up to the QCLI-516 Opus verdict (claude-opus-5-5, sha256 22f4825835d90a09809d2aa9d24c6489101f78d1d883a9adb88d6d61cce2be56, verbatim on QCLI-516). NOT on the critical path, but to be considered BEFORE quest latest moves. MINOR 1: the hint at promote-release.mjs (~:1103 via repairHint) fires on ANY failed post-move cut. If gh release create succeeded and only gh release edit --latest failed (github-release.mjs ~:321-335), the printed gh release create refuses with already exists; the right command is gh release edit v<ver> -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --latest. Key the hint on cut.detail/the failed action, or name both commands. Fail-safe and pre-existing: the plain-path hint has the same shape. MINOR 2: the printed line is a template, not a runnable command (the <the ... heading> placeholder parses as a stdin redirect, which fails closed); give a recipe that writes the body-only notes file from the section at the notes sha, or point at a script that does. NITS: hint hard-codes the title and ignores releaseTitle never-published variant (harmless, n/a for 0.14.1); test rename fixture filename/previous_filename names swapped (~:214-216); long unwrapped comment lines at test:12 and promote-release.mjs:912.

acceptanceCriteria.text: After a post-move failure of only the --latest edit, the printed repair names gh release edit ... --latest, not gh release create; after a failed create it names the create command; a test covers each and goes red when the hint is keyed on the wrong action.
The hint gives a runnable recipe, or names a script, that writes the body-only notes file for the notes sha, so no placeholder redirect is left in the printed command.
The swapped rename fixture names and the two long comment lines are fixed.
